high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by Vogue Magazine. The post was shared 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 7:48 AM. The image features two individuals, a man and a woman, standing close together against a dark background with a blurred, warm-toned backdrop that appears to be part of a movie or event poster. The man is dressed in a black suit with a black shirt, and he has short brown hair. The woman is wearing a pink dress adorned with black floral embellishments and has her blonde hair styled in an updo. She is also wearing a ring on her left hand
